g.text: heapless 0.9.3: pop after a write through the view
find_mut returns a view of bravo, and a write through it sets maybe_changed
pop() unlinks node 1, puts it on the free list and hands bravo! to the caller
The view drops with the flag still set and unlinks node 1 again, cutting alpha off
It reads bravo! out a second time and pushes the copy back, into a node still on the free list
The caller drops its String, and the list now points at freed memory
heapless 0.9.4: pop() clears the flag first, so the view does nothing when it drops
